sentences.text: For a missed EMI, the applicable directions allow penal charges instead of penal interest, and they must be reasonable, non-discriminatory, and levied only on the amount under default. [E8, E9, E15]
The directions also say that no upper limit or cap for penal charges has been prescribed. [E15]
So the evidence does not support a maximum penal charge in rupees for one missed EMI. [E15]

No further rupee figure can be given from the evidence because the amount must be disclosed in the loan agreement and KFS, and the evidence provided does not state a specific charge amount for this loan. [E16, E17]

missing.slot: maximum penal charge in rupees for one missed EMI
